beats.text: Every November, my whole town sets one extra plate at dinner.

overlay.name: HARLOW CREEK
overlay.sub: Set a place for him tonight

beats.text: Nobody says who it's for. You just do it.
I'd just moved here alone. I thought it was a joke.
So I didn't set the plate.
My neighbor Ruth, pale, holding a plate.
She said, take mine. He's counting the houses.
I laughed and shut the door.
Every window on the street held one candle. Except mine.
Footsteps crossed my kitchen. A chair scraped back.
Something sat at my table. Waiting.
I grabbed Ruth's plate and slid it across.
It ate. Slowly. Then it stood, and left.
In the morning, Ruth's house was dark.
She'd given me her only plate.
Her empty table was the one he visited next.
A new family moved in across the street today.
I'll bring them a plate. Just not mine.
